method: Single AI selected crest/tail regions after native inspection. Same neutral-pixel rule as F3 Im4: RGB chroma<=32 and 255-max>=32,64,96; SciPy eight-connected components, all retained. No threshold chosen as best.

regions.interpretation: Visual same-color approach/crossing near the crest. One long connected component cannot prove one model owns all its pixels. Small fragments remain candidates; no identity is propagated through the meeting region. Threshold32 also retains a single isolated pixel; it is not silently discarded.

The long component includes the visible axis/tick system and reaches both horizontal region limits. It is not a valid whole curve. A short component separated at thresholds64/96 merges at32; therefore connectivity-based endpoints depend on threshold. No physical terminal zero or failure displacement is inferred.

limits: Regions are exploratory source-inspection locators, not the final quantile-selected review slots.
Bounding boxes include blank space; they are not stroke masks or uncertainty bounds.
No spring/shell difference, model validity, actual connection capacity or collapse-cause conclusion.
